Path 1, deliveryGOALS §1.2

GitOps Promoter

Our lean for promotion: every environment change is a pull request.

WHAT IT IS

An Argo Labs project that promotes between environments by opening PRs against per-environment branches, gated by commit statuses that prove the checks passed.

WHAT SETS IT APART

No state outside Git: the PR is the audit trail, readable by anyone with repo access. Designed around hydrated manifests. Linear pipelines today; DAG promotion is on its roadmap.

WHERE WE STAND

Our preferred option going into the spike. Watch for: per-environment commit statuses wired by hand, and less adoption data than Kargo.

GitOps Promoter docs; ArgoCon's agent-ready checklist, KubeCon NA 2026

DECIDE

GitOps Promoter: Our lean for promotion: every environment change is a pull request. Where we stand: Our preferred option going into the spike. Watch for: per-environment commit statuses wired by hand, and less adoption data than Kargo. ArgoCon showed it as the traceability mechanism in the agent-ready checklist, which is part of why we lean this way: it serves the agent path too.
